```{r}
library(Biostrings)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

calc_n50_stats <- function(fasta_file, assembly_name) {
  # Read fasta
  seqs <- readDNAStringSet(fasta_file)
  
  # Get contig lengths and sort descending
  lengths <- width(seqs)
  lengths <- sort(lengths, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  # Calculate cumulative length - convert to numeric first
  cum_length <- cumsum(as.numeric(lengths)) 
  total_length <- sum(as.numeric(lengths))  
  
  # Create dataframe for Nx values
  nx_values <- seq(0, 100, by = 1)
  nx_lengths <- sapply(nx_values, function(x) {
    threshold <- total_length * (x/100)
    if(x == 0) return(max(lengths))
    if(x == 100) return(min(lengths))
    
    idx <- which(cum_length >= threshold)[1]
    if(is.na(idx)) return(min(lengths))
    return(lengths[idx])
  })
  
  # Create dataframe
  data.frame(
    assembly = assembly_name,
    Nx = nx_values,
    length = nx_lengths,
    total_length = total_length,
    n_contigs = length(lengths),
    N50 = nx_lengths[51]
  )
}

# Calculate for both assemblies
asm1 <- calc_n50_stats("/Users/ksenia/Documents/Lab_Garvan/projects/marsupials/PromethION/published_genome/Dunnart_asm_12-2021_sm.fa", "Dunnart_asm_12-2021_sm")
asm2 <- calc_n50_stats("/Users/ksenia/Documents/Lab_Garvan/projects/marsupials/PromethION/genome_final/dunnart_male_T2T_chr.fasta", "Dunnart_T2T")

# Combine data
df <- rbind(asm1, asm2)


# Create N50 plot
setwd("/Users/ksenia/Documents/Lab_Garvan/projects/marsupials/PromethION/N50/")
pdf("dunnart_genomes_N50_T2T.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
print(ggplot(df, aes(x = Nx, y = length/1e6, color = assembly)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(data = df %>% filter(Nx == 50), 
             aes(yintercept = length/1e6, color = assembly), 
             linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#E63946", "#1D3557")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) + 
  labs(
    x = "Nx (%)",
    y = "Contig Length (Mb)",
    color = "Assembly",
    title = "Genome Assembly Nx Plot",
    subtitle = paste0("N50 values: ", 
                     "Dunnart_asm_12-2021_sm = ", round(unique(asm1$N50)/1e6, 2), " Mb, ",
                     "Dunnart_T2T = ", round(unique(asm2$N50)/1e6, 2), " Mb")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ))
dev.off()


# Print summary stats
summary_stats <- df %>%
  group_by(assembly) %>%
  summarise(
    N50_Mb = round(first(N50)/1e6, 2),
    Total_length_Gb = round(first(total_length)/1e9, 2),
    N_contigs = first(n_contigs)
  )
print(summary_stats)
```
